lines: I looked up at that night sky
It felt closer than usual
As if saying goodbye to the gloomy days
I spread my wounded wings
I ran forward and took flight
Like a light drifting across the night sky
I flapped and my heart surged
When this beat resounds
The brightest star becomes my guide
Carry me far beyond
A tiny star that might be swallowed by the endless sky flickers
I wish I could become that earnest form
To the battered reality
Life’s meaning and purpose have vanished
Yet my chest still beats surely
I lit a fire in the heart that was fading
Shine
Color it, look
Even pain and suffering
Can be turned into strength
With these wings I can soar
When morning comes, light streams in
I place my hope in the world again
When night falls, I know loneliness
It was a meaningless repetition
But at last I found
A place where this life shines
Let’s go on forever
To the very edge of the sky
I ran forward and took flight
Like a light drifting across the night sky
I flapped and my heart surged
Even if my body burns out
If someday this trail can illuminate someone
Now I become a star
And cross even the night
